description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewahamanduwa, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad Map No. 820010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
